newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian sharemarket rises in light holiday trade.
newsitem.headline: Estonian sharemarket rises in light holiday trade.

text.p: The Estonian stock market edged up on Monday but in sluggish, holiday trade with low investor activity and a turnover of just 15.3 million kroons, dealers said.
Prices saw slight changes as the index gained some 0.08 percent and rose to 160.78.
Market leader Hansabank was the most traded share again on the main list with volumes of seven million kroons but closed lower at 161.45 kroons versus 162.25.
Forekspank turned over 3.5 million kroons and also closed slightly lower at 122.20 kroons against 122.25.
The small Evea bank, which was introduced into the secondary list on Monday, turned over some 1.8 million kroons and closed at 25 kroons.
"There is a myth that every new stock on the bourse faces an enormous increase. This, probably, is the reason why Evea was so active," one dealer said.
Evea bank has 371 million kroons of eleven months assets and pre-tax profit of 9.1 million.
The second biggest bank Estonian Savings bank was trade worth 1.7 million kroons and ended higher at 68.75 kroons against 67.50.

The over-the-counter market was led by Tallinna Kaubamaja department store which turned over shares worth 2.3 million kroons and closed slightly higher at 76 kroons against 75.75 kroons. The total volume of the free market was 4.8 million kroons.
The Tallinn Stock Exchange is open on December 31 but closes an hour earlier than usual at 1100 GMT.
